cases.knownDivergence: ZUS paid a top-up to the 1000 zł minimum during the parental leave combined with 3/8-time work. From the Z-3 (about 3509.50 gross a month, base about 3028) the reduced parental benefit at 70% × 5/8 is about 1325 gross / 1166 net, above the floor, so the top-up does not reproduce from the file; the claimant's own etat, the exact rate and the month the top-up applied to are not legible. The extended end date 2027-04-17 itself does reproduce (224 × (1 + 3/8)).

cases.knownDivergence: Two points do not reproduce. (1) Parental length: 56 weeks were used (65 − 9, the single-child Za życiem length) although two children were born alive, for which 67 − 9 = 58 weeks would apply. (2) Work extension: at 1/2 time the 392 days were doubled to 784 because the extended part was itself combined with work (392 × (1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + …)); a one-step extension of days × f gives 588. The file does not say how ZUS or the employer counted either point.
